test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing towards the south (not necessarily in the same order). A and H are at extreme ends of the row. E and F are immediate neighbours of B. C is fourth to the left of B. F is to the immediate left of A. D is not the immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate right of E?
solution:
**Given**: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing towards the south (not necessarily in the same order).

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangements:

1. A and H are at extreme ends of the row.

From this, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4cacbe88e56caa3d20b62d3b8fbc8797ec7a2bb59f5e36611548ba646241293.png] 

2. E and F are immediate neighbours of B.

3. F is to the immediate left of A.

From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34d7e3506a33c83aebbc201775b5ae1e8de66fb779a573a6bee9953811a8b16e.png] 

4. C is fourth to the left of B.

5. D is not the immediate neighbour of C.

From this, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6c2849efac0e2cf87d302b1c506c698fe14a5d88d4cf0abc1dcad8fe6f2a8d0.png] 

Now, only G is left who takes the vacant position. The final arrangement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4747e7fd68dfb09a7b1209486dec20c5c08734c4203f374ba57a393c3844b02.png] 

Therefore, B sits to the immediate right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”
